firstInference.text: those old soldiers had long long ago forgotten about that old law of the long gone past but jim had treasured it up in his memory lo these many years and he thought it would serve him now as it had no doubt frequently done in the past having returned to the royal cavern calico first pounded the gong and then sat in the throne wearing ruggedo's discarded ruby crown and holding in his hand the scepter which ruggedo had so often thrown at his head how every pulse did beat and leap and how every heart did throb with emotions of joy which seemed nearly akin to heaven when we receive the glad intelligence of our onward march toward the land of promise and of our loved ones
